94    /**
95     * Generates a random National Insurance number.
96     *
97     * @see https://www.gov.uk/hmrc-internal-manuals/national-insurance-manual/nim39110
98     */
99    public function nino(): string
100    {
101        $prefixAllowList = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'E', 'G', 'H', 'J', 'K', 'L', 'M', 'N', 'O', 'P', 'R', 'S', 'T', 'W', 'X', 'Y', 'Z'];
102        $prefixBanList = ['BG', 'GB', 'KN', 'NK', 'NT', 'TN', 'ZZ'];
103
104        do {
105            $prefix = implode('', self::randomElements($prefixAllowList, 2, true));
106        } while (in_array($prefix, $prefixBanList, false) || $prefix[1] == 'O');
107
108        $digits = static::numerify('######');
109        $suffix = static::randomElement(['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']);
110
111        return sprintf('%s%s%s', $prefix, $digits, $suffix);
112    }
